title: Leibniz Institute of European History Mainz: Fellowships for Doctoral Students
summary: The Leibniz Institute of European History (IEG) in Mainz awards 6 to 12-month fellowships for doctoral students in European history, the history of religion, and other historical disciplines.

subject_areas.notes: European history, the history of religion, historical theology, or other historical disciplines.

institutions.notes: Leibniz Institute of European History (IEG) in Mainz.

nationality.notes: The fellowship is open to PhD students from Germany and abroad.

residence.notes: During the fellowship you are required to reside at the Institute in Mainz.

mandatory.text: PhD students must have been pursuing their doctorate for no more than 3 years at the time of taking up the fellowship
Required to reside at the Institute in Mainz during the fellowship
Actively participate in the IEG's research community, the weekly colloquia and scholarly activities
Present your work at least once during your fellowship
Proficiency in English is required to participate in discussions at the Institute

preferences.text: Particular interest is given to projects with a comparative or cross-border approach, on Europe in its relation to the wider world, on topics of intellectual and religious history, with digital tools and methods, or on environmental history
The IEG encourages applications from women
The IEG preferably supports the writing up of dissertations

exceptions.text: Exceptions to the 3-year limit for pursuing a doctorate may be made in exceptional circumstances

funding.description: The monthly stipend is 1,650 EUR. Additionally, you can apply for family or child allowance.

application_rounds.notes: Application deadline is 15 February for stays beginning in September. Extracted deadline was '02-15'; year not confirmed.
Application deadline is 15 August for stays beginning in March of the following year. Extracted deadline was '08-15'; year not confirmed.

recurring_deadline_notes: The application deadlines are 15 February for stays beginning in September and 15 August for stays beginning in March of the following year.

required_documents.text: Letters of recommendation should be submitted directly by the referees.

steps.text: Please apply via the online application portal.
